title: Screen and voice response behavior
summary: The fragments mention inconsistent screen touch registration and voice-command phrasing behavior, but the sample is too limited and sentiment-labeled only as undetermined.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments describe touch inputs not always registering, a voice command that works only with specific wording, one vague desired change, and one brief note that verbal responses do occur.

limitations: All sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, so the direction of customer sentiment cannot be concluded from this topic.
The examples mix at least two interface subjects—touchscreen responsiveness and voice-command wording—plus one vague change request, which limits topic coherence.
The sample is very small, so examples are insufficient for stronger pattern claims.
